Mission Local reported on April 9, 2025, that the State Bar had sent sitting District Attorney Brooke Jenkins to a diversionary program after ethics complaints. The story said the complaints were “best resolved” by requiring her participation, and that the matter centered on her accessing and emailing a confidential rap sheet.
